entries.finding_title: A stored Google Interaction was not cleaned up
entries.recommendation_title: Delete every stateful Interaction created by AIQA
entries.why: The opt-in stateful probe creates provider-side state and must leave no retained resource behind after the run.

attribution.basis: The provider did not confirm deletion of the resource created by the stateful compatibility probe.

steps.text: Delete the Interaction resource identified by the bounded hash in the evidence record, then verify that a follow-up lookup returns not-found.
Repair the gateway DELETE /interactions/{id} path and keep cleanup in a finally-style path for every stateful probe.
